root_cause.text: The qla2xxx driver does not validate the firmware-reported frame_size before using it to calculate copy length into a fixed-size 64-byte iocb array, allowing a larger-than-expected size to cause a memcpy overflow (buffer overflow).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that "the frame_size reported by firmware is used to calculate the copy length into item->iocb" and that "the iocb member is defined as a fixed-size 64-byte array" such that "if the reported frame_size exceeds 64 bytes, subsequent memcpy calls will overflow the iocb member boundary." The patch caps total_bytes to sizeof(item->iocb.iocb) to prevent this.
